exposure: Patients referred between January 2000 and December 2015 (Group 2)
Patients referred between February 1980 and December 1999 (Group 1)
cohort: 222 fetuses and infants with spina bifida diagnosed prenatally at a tertiary referral center between 1980 and 2015.
finding: Advances in conventional neonatology and pediatric neurosurgery have led to increased life expectancy and improved quality of life for infants with spina bifida.
